text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just before summer training camp ended—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hmph☆
Heave-hooo♪♪♪♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SPLAAAASH!!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —Fshuuuuuuu...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehe☆
It was only for a second, but it worked!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I call it the 'Splash on You☆Kick'!
With this, my very first goal is complete~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco's gotten
way stronger, right!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay~~~~☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco is at full power!
With these kicks, I'm gonna win, win, and keep on winning!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: If you do that, Falco will—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...No, it's nothing at all!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Falco's gonna go change, okay?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Peeking is strictly forbidden! ☆
Just kidding~♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...That's weird.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Win, win, and keep on winning.
That's why I'm gonna get stronger!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Even Madam President
went out of her way to come praise me.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm not wrong... right?
Then why am I...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —No, no, no! I'm letting my mind wander!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Right now, all I can do is win.
Because if I win—my dream will come true.
